title: chat-00: add jmap: strip to MessageAction forward rule
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L408 says servers MUST store and forward MessageAction records without inspection or transformation except user-reference mapping, but object-uri-00 L86 and federation-00 L337 require receiving servers to remove MessageActions/Endpoints whose uri is a jmap: URI. Add that removal to the L408 exception list. crate-jmap implements the strip (JMAP-0x0q.40).
